newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill restarts food stocks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill restarts food stocks.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it reinstated coverage of food stocks.
-- Sara Lee Corp was reinstated as a near-term accumulate and long-term buy. The stock rose 3/8 to 39-1/2.
-- General Mills Inc was restarted as near-term accumulate and long-term buy. The stock rose 1-1/4 to 61-1/2.
-- McCormick and Co Inc was restarted with near-term and long-term accumulate. The stock rose 1/4 to 23-1/4.
-- H.J. Heinz Co was restarted as near- and long-term accumulate. The stock rose 1/8 to 38.
-- Kellogg Co was restarted at near-term neutral and long-term accumulate. The stock rose 3/8 to 68-5/8.
-- Quaker Oats Co was restarted as near-term neutral and long-term accumulate. The stock fell 1/8 to 37-3/8.
-- Ralcorp Holdings Inc was restarted as near-term neutral and long-term buy. The stock fell 3/8 to 19-1/4.
-- Ralston Purina Co was restarted as near-term neutral and long-term buy. The stock rose 3/8 to 76-3/4.
